message.content:
Below is a concise list of **long‑weekend** periods in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that either falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, or is observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend.  

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday | Provinces / Territories Affected |
|-------------------|---------|----------------------------------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | All provinces & territories |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (observed Mon Feb 20) | AB, BC, SK, MB, ON, NB, NS, PE |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (observed Mon May 22) | All provinces & territories |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | All provinces & territories |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (observed Mon Sep 4) | All provinces & territories |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (observed Mon Oct 9) | All provinces & territories |
| **Oct 14–16** | Heritage Day (observed Mon Oct 16) | BC |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | All provinces & territories |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day (observed Mon Dec 25) | All provinces & territories |

### Notes

* **Observances on Mondays:** When a holiday falls on a weekend, the next working day (usually Monday) is observed as the holiday. This creates a three‑day weekend.  
* **Provincial Variations:** Some holidays are only observed in certain provinces or territories. For instance, Family Day is celebrated in most provinces except Quebec, where Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day is observed instead.  
* **Non‑Long Weekend Holidays:** Other provincial holidays such as St. Patrick’s Day (ON), St. Jean Baptiste Day (QC), St. Joseph’s Day (NL), and St. George’s Day (PE) did not create long weekends in 2023 because they fell on weekdays.

Feel free to integrate this table into your holiday‑planning app!
